html:
G'oya

Avval har bir mahsulotning jami sotuvi: SUM(quantity), mahsulot id si bo'yicha guruhlab. Keyin har bir kategoriyadagi eng katta jami. Oxirida har bir mahsulotni o'z kategoriyasining maksimumi bilan solishtiramiz va tenglarini qoldiramiz. Teng birinchi o'rinlar shu yo'l bilan o'zi chiqadi, chunki hech narsa LIMIT bilan kesilmaydi.

Yechim

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, SUM(s.quantity) AS total
  FROM products p
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
best AS (
  SELECT category, MAX(total) AS max_total
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT t.category, t.name AS product, t.total AS total_quantity
FROM totals t
JOIN best b ON b.category = t.category AND b.max_total = t.total

Oddiy JOIN sales hech qachon sotilmagan mahsulotlarni darhol tashlab yuboradi, shart ham shuni so'raydi. Namunada Non 13 (10 + 3), Sut 15 (7 + 8), Oziq-ovqatda g'olib Sut. Kanselyariyada Daftar 20 bilan.

Tuzoqlar

Eng katta bitta sotuv bilan jami sotuvni adashtirish. MAX(quantity) bilan namunada Non (bir martada 10 ta) Sutdan (8 ta) oldinga chiqadi, jami esa Sutda ko'p:

Noto'g'riWITH totals AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, MAX(s.quantity) AS total
  FROM products p
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
best AS (
  SELECT category, MAX(total) AS max_total
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT t.category, t.name AS product, t.total AS total_quantity
FROM totals t
JOIN best b ON b.category = t.category AND b.max_total = t.total

Faqat name bo'yicha guruhlash. Bir kategoriyada ikki xil "Choy" bo'lsa, ularning sotuvi qo'shilib, aslida yo'q mahsulot g'olib bo'lib qoladi. Shuning uchun GROUP BY da p.id turibdi.

best dagi GROUP BY category ni unutsangiz, butun do'kon bo'yicha bitta g'olib qoladi va qolgan kategoriyalar natijadan yo'qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

RANK() oyna funksiyasi teng natijalarga bir xil o'rin beradi, shuning uchun r = 1 hamma g'oliblarni qoldiradi. ROW_NUMBER() esa tenglardan bittasini tashlab yuborardi:

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, SUM(s.quantity) AS total
  FROM products p
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT category, name, total,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY total DESC) AS r
  FROM totals
)
SELECT category, name AS product, total AS total_quantity
FROM ranked
WHERE r = 1
